beats.subline: Friday, November 13, 2026 close — stocks rebounded for the week even as Nvidia extended its slide to a fresh 52-week low.
beats.body: Markets clawed back most of the prior week's AI-driven selloff even though Nvidia fell again to a 52-week low following Jensen Huang's ouster; hot October wholesale inflation data added late-week pressure, and markets were closed over the weekend before Monday's session, with Nvidia's earnings and Anthropic's IPO pricing both ahead this week.

beats.headline: Trump departs for Asia trip culminating in first Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral meeting
beats.body: President Trump left Monday for a multi-day Asia trip that takes him to the ASEAN summit in the Philippines before a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Thursday; the White House says the first-of-its-kind three-way meeting will focus on reducing nuclear weapons proliferation, and Trump said he also hopes to meet North Korea's Kim Jong Un while in China.

beats.headline: Taiwan coast guard tracks Chinese ship after radio standoff over sovereignty claims east of island
beats.body: Taiwan's Coast Guard Administration said its cutter Hualien confronted a Chinese coast guard ship about 40 nautical miles southeast of Orchid Island on November 12, with each side broadcasting rival sovereignty claims over the radio; Taiwan said Saturday it will keep monitoring Chinese vessels in the area and called the patrol a violation of the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea.

beats.headline: Iran claims Strait of Hormuz shipping lanes are mined; CENTCOM says routes remain clear
beats.body: Iran's Revolutionary Guard was cited by Saudi-linked Asharq News as claiming the Strait of Hormuz's southern shipping lanes, which the US calls safe, are now 'fully mined,' though the Guard issued no statement of its own; US Central Command chief Adm. Brad Cooper has said American forces cleared the main transit routes of Iranian mines and remain 'highly vigilant' there.

beats.headline: Pentagon names seven companies for December counter-drone laser 'shoot-off'
beats.body: Joint Interagency Task Force 401 selected Allen Control Systems, Aurelius Systems, BlueHalo, Kord Technologies, IPG Photonics, Thor Dynamics and Yrikka to demonstrate high-energy laser weapons against drone targets at Dugway Proving Ground, Utah starting mid-December, with an eye toward quickly issuing purchase orders for systems that perform well.

beats.headline: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner to invest $5 billion in Anthropic's IPO, 5x his biggest-ever bet
beats.body: Gerstner told CNBC his firm plans to put $5 billion into Anthropic's IPO, calling the AI company a long-term 'cornerstone compounder'; Anthropic is expected to price around $70-$78 a share and list on Nasdaq Thursday at roughly a $1.4 trillion valuation, which would make it the first major AI lab to go public, ahead of OpenAI.
